title: Gator Radar – Curated SFSU Opportunity Pilot
scopeNotes: Structured transcription of previously shared SFSU Fall 2026 fitness flyer, official Student Events Calendar PDF pp.4–7, GatorXperience screenshots, ORC booking screenshot, and prior official source URLs in conversation.
A user-provided official screenshot proves what was LISTED at capture, not that seats remain or the event cannot be cancelled.
No invented end times: null means missing. For an item with schedulable:false do not insert as a precise time block without resolving reviewFlags.
Fitness weekday recurring flyer has been expanded into October 5–16 occurrence records including Saturday October 10. Confirm exceptional closures and actual booking availability.
The screenshot contains a potential 5:30–6:30 AM typo for ORC Gear Demo; stored exactly as displayed and blocked from scheduling until confirmed.
Group fitness source URL is a published schedule document; GatorXperience screenshots lack per-event URLs. SourceUrl may be null; DO NOT manufacture URLs.
Do not use any stale Gemini result/snapshot previously computed against fictional opportunities. Version all cache keys with this datasetId.
Do not represent popularity counts from demo as real community activity.

recommendationEligible=false for tentative listings, broad league or drop-in windows, and sensitive service listings. The full Discover index may still show them as information with appropriate explanation.
